name: Fujiwara no Teika
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 97); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1242.

poems.title: Upon the shore of Matsu-hō
poems.author: Fujiwara no Teika
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 97
poems.text:
Upon the shore of Matsu-hō
For thee I pine and sigh;
Though calm and cool the evening air,
These salt-pans caked and dry
Are not more parched than I!
